comparator.name: Bachelor Applied Physics
comparator.sourceNotes: Freshly retrieved 2026–2027 Applied Physics after-revision PER, Articles 3.3–3.5 and Appendix 2 pp.72–78, governs this ordinary English full-time programme. All 27 credited positions total 60 + 60 + 60 = 180: core 125 including exact 33BFP final project 15, ITEC 10 and genuine electives 45 (20 year two, 25 year three). No named specialization is required. All taught core units are 5 under the explicit quarter convention; 3SAFE is required noncredit safety training, not an extra 5-EC unit. PPD and first-/second-year challenges are embedded; MyFuture requires value seven without credits, and at least five Studium Generale activities belong within ITEC. Elective space requires examination-board approval and no substantive overlap, at least 30 credits at levels 2/3 including 15 at level 3. The formal requirement list uses current Calculus 2MCALCAP, titled Calculus variant 3, replacing the earlier completed 2WCB0 option for pre-September-2026 students; the pilot appendix prints a different legacy code 2WBB0. These legacy references do not add another course or affect the current 5-credit position. The final project is a 15-credit block in Q4 or another quarter, or spread across two consecutive quarters. Entry requires 120 total, all compulsory first-year components, at least 110 core/ITEC credits and successful 33ACE; Appendix 2 permits meeting these conditions within 15 working days after starting, otherwise continuation stops. Laboratory components and project require successful 3SAFE. Future scheduling remains subject to applicable course conditions. No new UCR judgment is made.
